Usage: dpkg-deb [-cefxX] FILE [DIR]

Perform actions on Debian packages (.deb)

	-c	List files
	-f	Print control fields
	-e	Extract control files to DIR (default: ./DEBIAN)
	-x	Extract files to DIR (no default)
	-X	Verbose extract
